_comment: VS Code + GitHub Copilot (Agent mode) MCP config. Save as .vscode/mcp.json in your workspace (or merge into the 'mcp' section of settings.json). Replace /ABS/PATH. NOTE: Copilot Agent mode uses a CLOUD model, so your register map / tool results leave the machine to that model - only use it where that is acceptable; for on-prem-only, use Continue with local vLLM instead. Absolute paths make it cwd-independent.
